pages.layoutNotes: First photographed page of the drinks booklet (not a cover; no logo visible). White page, single left text column: bold dark-grey item names, small grey ingredient line underneath, prices '€ 9,00' right-aligned in a column. Category title in a gold/ochre rounded pill with white italic bold sans text, top-left, with a slight shadow/curl. Top-right: small orange/ochre italic caption 'in abbinamento tagliere salumi tartare di pesce' above a circular photo framed by a thin gold ring. Bottom right: cut-out photo of a copper Moscow-Mule mug with mint and a Corona can (continues onto page 2), small orange zig-zag decor strokes.

crops.depicts: Circular photo: board of salami/cured meats and pink fish (tuna) tartare cubes, gold ring frame

pages.layoutNotes: No heading; continues Cocktail & Long Drinks. Text column right of centre: first a tight list of gin/vodka 'Tonic o Lemon' items (brand bold, 'Tonic o Lemon' regular), then cocktails with ingredient sub-lines. Prices right-aligned. Left: cut-out (no frame) photo of Corona Extra can, mason-jar Mojito with mint and copper mule mug, spanning the gutter from page 1. Small orange dot decor top-left.

crops.depicts: Cut-out photo: Corona Extra can, Mojito in mason-jar glass with mint, copper Moscow Mule mug (left edge shows part of p1 tagliere photo)

pages.layoutNotes: Left page of the spread with page 4: no text; a large circular cocktail photo sits across the gutter (left half here, right half on page 4). Same photo as on page 4.

pages.layoutNotes: Continues cocktails (no heading at top; first price '€ 8,00' printed above Manhattan line). Left: large circular photo of three cocktails (yellow passion-fruit coupe, blue layered glass, red crystal tumbler with rosemary, lime glass) crossing the gutter.

crops.depicts: Circular photo: passion-fruit yellow cocktail, blue cocktail, red cocktail with rosemary, gin tonic with lime
